title: package_export_entry
description: Closed canonical schema for one package_export instruction entry. Validated before path evaluation or export. Schema validation is intentionally isolated from filesystem existence and path-root checks.

id.description: Stable semantic identity of the entry. Must be unique across the manifest.

path.description: Source path of the instruction entry.

target.description: Resolved target of the instruction entry.

required.description: Whether the entry is mandatory for the package to be valid.

metadata.description: Supported optional metadata. Closed: unknown keys are rejected.

version.description: Optional semantic version of the entry payload.
